name: consumer-information-notice
title: Consumer Information Notice
for_each: select v.id, v.ref || ' ' || v.make || ' ' || v.model as name from vehicles v where v.kind = 'stock' and v.status = 'in_stock' and v.cin_completed_on is not null

sections.title: Vehicle
sections.note: Displayed on the vehicle before it is offered for sale (Consumer Information Standards (Used Motor Vehicles) Regulations 2008).
sections.sql: select v.make, v.model, v.year, v.vin, v.plate as registration, v.odometer_km as odometer_km, v.colour, round(v.asking_cents / 100.0, 2) as price_nzd from vehicles v where v.id = $1

sections.title: Declarations
sections.sql: select to_char(v.cin_completed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as notice_completed, case when v.ppsr_checked_on is null then 'not yet searched' when v.security_interest then 'YES: registered security interest' else 'no (PPSR searched ' || to_char(v.ppsr_checked_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')' end as money_owing_on_vehicle, case when v.wof_issued_on is null then 'none on record' else to_char(v.wof_issued_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') end as wof_issued, coalesce(v.source, 'unknown') as how_acquired from vehicles v where v.id = $1

name: offer-and-sale
title: Vehicle offer and sale agreement
for_each: select d.id, d.ref || ' ' || c.name as name from deals d join customers c on c.id = d.customer_id where d.status in ('deposit', 'delivered')

sections.title: Parties
sections.sql: select c.name as purchaser, c.phone, c.email, coalesce(c.address || ', ' || c.suburb, c.suburb) as address, s.name as salesperson from deals d join customers c on c.id = d.customer_id join staff s on s.id = d.staff_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: Vehicle
sections.sql: select v.make, v.model, v.year, v.vin, v.plate as registration, v.odometer_km, to_char(v.wof_issued_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as wof_issued, case when v.as_is_ack_on is not null then 'SOLD AS IS, WHERE IS: acknowledgment signed ' || to_char(v.as_is_ack_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else 'sold with warrant of fitness' end as condition_of_sale from deals d join vehicles v on v.id = d.vehicle_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: The sale
sections.note: Balances are stated from the record; nothing here is generated.
sections.sql: select round(d.sale_price_cents / 100.0, 2) as sale_price_nzd, round(coalesce(d.deposit_cents, 0) / 100.0, 2) as deposit_nzd, d.trade_in_desc as trade_in, round(coalesce(d.trade_in_allowance_cents, 0) / 100.0, 2) as trade_allowance_nzd, round((d.sale_price_cents - coalesce(d.deposit_cents, 0) - coalesce(d.trade_in_allowance_cents, 0)) / 100.0, 2) as balance_nzd, coalesce(d.payment_method, 'to be confirmed') as payment, coalesce(to_char(d.delivered_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'to be confirmed') as delivery from deals d where d.id = $1

name: service-history
title: Service history
for_each: select v.id, v.ref || ' ' || v.make || ' ' || v.model as name from vehicles v where exists (select 1 from repair_orders r where r.vehicle_id = v.id and r.status = 'completed')

sections.title: Vehicle
sections.sql: select v.make, v.model, v.year, v.vin, v.plate as registration, v.odometer_km as current_odometer_km from vehicles v where v.id = $1

sections.title: Work history
sections.note: The full workshop record, oldest first. This document is worth real money at resale time.
sections.sql: select to_char(r.on_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, r.type, r.reason, r.odometer_km, r.notes, s.name as technician, case when r.wof_result is not null then 'WoF ' || r.wof_result end as wof from repair_orders r join staff s on s.id = r.staff_id where r.vehicle_id = $1 and r.status = 'completed' order by r.on_date

name: customer-statement
title: Statement of account
for_each: select c.id, c.name from customers c where exists (select 1 from invoices i where i.customer_id = c.id and i.status = 'issued')

sections.title: Invoices outstanding
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.unit, to_char(i.issued_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as issued, to_char(i.due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as due, round(i.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total_nzd, i.state from v_invoices i where i.customer_id = $1 and i.status = 'issued' order by i.issued_on

sections.title: Recent payments
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.unit, to_char(i.paid_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as paid, round(i.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total_nzd from v_invoices i where i.customer_id = $1 and i.status = 'paid' order by i.paid_on desc limit 6
